title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): simplified agent creation experience
notes: claim 69: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing asserts that existing sharing controls govern agents produced by the new experience, although its authoring surface is not confirmed. The licensing paragraph omits required billing-policy conditions for SharePoint grounding, and one sentence incorrectly says the roadmap gives no date.

claims.claim: The per-agent block or unblock control governs access across the organisation.

claims.claim: The package-block API is a beta API.

claims.claim: Existing access, sharing and block settings still apply to the agents produced by this new creation experience.
claims.quote: Searched: '506848 Agent Builder simplified creation control settings licensing'. Read Agent settings and Agent Builder guidance: Sharing covers only Agent Builder; no source identifies the new surface or confirms that Sharing governs its output.
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with: 'Low. The roadmap describes a simpler, faster creation flow and states no new data access or actions; it does not identify the authoring surface, so the documented Agent Builder controls are background only.'

claims.claim: The record gives no dates for the change.

claims.fix: Replace 'The record gives no screens or dates for the change' with 'The record gives no screens or rollout window beyond the December CY2025 target'.

claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to check User access, Sharing and catalog submissions, but the controls table contains only Block.
claims.quote: Check Agents > Settings > User access; Review Agents > Settings > Sharing; Review any submissions waiting for approval to the org catalog. The controls table has only 'Whether a specific agent is available to anyone in the organisation (block or unblock)'.
claims.fix: The Before rollout User access and Sharing steps, At rollout catalog-submission review, and After rollout User access and Sharing re-check have no corresponding table rows. Remove those checklist instructions rather than adding controls during correction.
